buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK 1.0 Checking of foundation /Anti vibration mounting pads, for its tightness and re-tightening of the same , if required. 2.0 Checking of Alignment of Engine/Alternator and rectify the same, if required. 3.0 Checking & tightening of coupling bolts, if required. 4.0 Checking & tightening of bolts of Engine & Alternator Base/Legs. 5.0 Inspection of Diesel tanks, Diesel lines and to clean the same, if required. 6.0 To carry out routine Maintenance service as above mentioned. 7.0 To carry out the valve adjustment (tappet Clarence) as per the schedule. 8.0 Checking of various gauges for its correct functioning. 9.0 To carry out the checks of all cable's termination/terminal bolts and tightening, if required. 10.0 To Carrey out the Nozzle calibration as per the schedule. 11.0 Service Engineer shall carry out scheduled preventive maintenance on Diesel Generating set as per the standard check list. 12.0 Carrey out necessary repairs, adjustment of assemblies, sub-assemblies in order to keep the DG set in good working condition. 13.0 During the visit service Engineer shall report the performance of any abnormality and inform parts r equirements for procurement. 14.0 The service Engineer shall train the operation and maintenance personal daily checking of DG sets.

15.0 Pre intimate to NNTPS/NLC India Ltd on Engine condition based on Engine performance parameters. 16.0 Checking of all electrical connection for its proper tightness including charging Alternators and Engi ne control. 17.0 Supply of spares which is not mentioned in Annexure A will be scope of NLC India Ltd/ NNTPS. 18.0 Any third party workshop charges for repairing the Genset including to & fro transportation will be p aid by NLCIL. ***** 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SPECIAL CONDITIONS Part-I 1.0 The quoted price shall be firm and shall be inclusive of all charges to & fro, staying at local conveya nce and other charges including all taxes. 2.0 Totally 12 visits per DG set for Two years. Visit will be carried out on bi-monthly basis. Date & Time of visit will be intimated by NLC India Ltd/NNTPS in one week advance. 3.0 The service engineer should bring necessary special tools. 4.0 The contractor should take care of the safety of their workmen. 5.0 Necessary check list along with the field service report need to be submitted to NNTPS during each visit. 6.0 The work shall be carried out under the direction of NLCIL/NNTPS Engineers. 7.0 Any third party workshop charged required for the repairing of the Genset will be charged extra incl uding to & fro transportations. 8.0 Service engineer shall carry out scheduled preventive maintenance on Diesel Generating set as per the standard check list. 9.0 PENAULTY CLAUSE 9.1 If service is not carried out as per above Part-1 Sl. no.2 penalty of Rs.1,000/- will be recovere d per visit and the same will be deducted from the next running bills of the contract. 9.2 Breakdown calls are to be attended within 48 Hrs of reporting of defects/breakdown, failing which 0.5 % of per visit charges per day subject to the maximum of 5 % of total contract value will be deducted from the bills of the contract, Part-II 1.0 SUPERVISOR CHARGES – PENALTY CLAUSE Not Applicable 2.0 Tools & tackles, lifting machines & Safety appliances that are used for the work or by the workmen / Supervisor / Engineer / Technician should posses ISI mark and valid test certificate from the compete nt authority. 3.0 The Contractor should observe all safety rules and regulations in force and ensure that all necessar y safety precautions are followed up strictly for the safety of workmen / Supervisor / Engineer / Tech nician engaged in the work. 4.0 The Contractor should engage adequate man power having appropriate skills with the approval of t he NLCIL officials to carryout and complete the works. Any extra time / over time engagement of the man power shall be the contractor’s responsibility. 5.0 RATE REVISION (NOT APPLICABLE). 6.0 CONTRACT WORKMEN DEATH RELIEF FUND (CWDF) 6.1 An amount equivalent to 0.2% (zero point two percent) of gross value of every bill payable (b efore statutory, non statutory deductions) shall be deducted towards “Contract Workmen Deat h Relief Fund” (CWDF) from the contractors for the works carried out by the contractor. No pro

vision has been made in the estimate towards the above deduction. 6.2 Based on the modified DRF scheme, monthly contributions to the death relief fund of Contrac t Workmen / Supervisors shall be deducted by the Contractor Employers concerned @ Rs.25/- from every contract workman / Supervisors engaged by Contractor Employer for the works in NLCIL from their salary /wages payable. In order to facilitate this, necessary deduction will be made from the bills of the Contractor employers based on Form - D (Attendance Register) & F orm -B (Wage Register) Equal monthly contribution to the fund @ Rs.25/- per contract workma n / Supervisors will be made by the Principal Employer NLCIL i.e. the Concerned Unit Head / U nit Accounts Centre. 7.0 CONTRACT WORKMAN AGE The contractor shall not engage workmen beyond 60 years and the Contractor s hall also produce the required age proof for the workmen engaged by him, while applying for entry permit for first time. 8.0 ESI & EPF The Contractor Employers shall be required to undertake the responsibility of re mitting the contribution/ subscription etc., of the contract workmen / Supervisor / Engineer / Technician engaged by them towards EPF, ESI etc., (as applicable). 9.0 SAFETY Personal protective equipments (PPE) ie like Helmet, Safety shoe, Goggles etc b y to be provided by the contractor and it is in the scope of the contractor. 10.0 PRICE REDUCTION CLAUSE Not Applicable 11.0 GUARANTEE FOR WARRANTY Not Applicable 12.0 CONTRACT PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE Not Applicable 13.0 PERIOD OF CONTRACT Two years from service start date as per GeM contract. Note: Lead days of 3 days are provided to the Service Provider for necessary mobilization for offering servi ce. Thus the service start date will commence from minimum 3 days after contract generation date. 14.0 PAYMENT TERMS 14.1 Payment for service: Payment will be made in twelve equal instalments for Two Year after co mpletion of each preventive maintenance activity as specified in the scope of work of the cont ract and the invoice raised by the contractor. 14.2 The payments will be made within 30 days of submission and acceptance of Invoice. Paymen t will be restricted to the actual work done only. The Final bill payment will be given only after finalization of contract. 15.0 GST (Goods and Service Tax) Contractor has to furnish the GST Registration number with relevant docume ntary evidence. Contractor has to comply with the GST Act/ Rules. 16.0 NLCIL reserves the right to short close / extend the contract due to special circumstances. 17.0 The General Conditions clauses 12.0 & 35.19 are not applicable.
